basis.description: What the forecast rests on, such as the signed contracts; attach them as evidence.
examples: Signed contracts with Lumen Health and Acme Analytics

forecast_on.description: The day the forecast was made: its 12 months run from it. Today or earlier.

value.description: The taxable supplies expected in the 12 months, in Singapore dollars: standard-rated and zero-rated sales, without exempt or out-of-scope sales or sales of the company's own assets.
